name: volume_sum_mem_Icc_le
summary: Induction on n through recursion, for D of either sign: integrate over the first coordinate x the bound |(D − x)^n/n!| for the remaining n coordinates at the level d − x ≤ D − x. The slice at x is empty unless 0 ≤ x ≤ d ≤ D, so the integrand is supported in the unordered interval between D and 0 (uIcc D 0; when D < 0 the set is empty), and ∫ over uIoc D 0 of |D − x|^n/n! dx = |D|^{n+1}/(n+1)! = ‖D^{n+1}/(n+1)!‖.

steps.claim: n = 0: the set lies in the interval [d − 1, d], of length 1 = |D⁰/0!|.

n + 1: split off one coordinate (volume_preserving_piFinSuccAbove, Fubini/Tonelli as a product measure): the measure is at most ∫ over x of the measure of the slice, which vanishes unless 0 ≤ x ≤ d ≤ D and, by the statement for n at the level d − x ≤ D − x (the lemma itself, by recursion), is at most |(D − x)^n/n!|. The integrand is therefore supported in the unordered interval uIcc D 0 between D and 0 (for d ≤ D < 0 no slice is nonempty), the integral may be taken over uIoc D 0 (equal almost everywhere), and ∫_{uIoc D 0} |D − x|^n/n! dx = |D|^{n+1}/(n+1)! = |D^{n+1}/(n+1)!|, whatever the sign of D.
steps.lean:
grw [← (volume_preserving_piFinSuccAbove _ 0).symm.measure_preimage_equiv, volume_eq_prod,
    prod_apply_le (by measurability), ← setLIntegral_eq_of_support_subset (s := .uIcc D 0) fun x
    h ↦ (nonempty_of_measure_ne_zero h).elim _, ← setLIntegral_congr uIoc_ae_eq_interval,
    lintegral_mono ((measure_mono _).trans <| volume_sum_mem_Icc_le <| sub_le_sub_right hd ·),
    ← ofReal_integral_norm_eq_lintegral_enorm (Continuous.integrableOn_uIoc (by fun_prop))] <;> simp
    [← ofReal_norm, integral_div, abs_sub_comm D, integral_pow_abs_sub_uIoc,
    @Fin.forall_fin_succ (succ _), factorial] <;> grind [Finset.sum_nonneg, Set.mem_uIcc]
